questions.stem: A student places a thermometer in a flask of germinating peas and another in a flask of dead peas. After 24 hours, the germinating peas flask is warmer. What does this demonstrate?

options.text: Dead peas absorb heat from the surroundings
Germinating peas release heat energy during respiration
The thermometer in the dead peas flask is faulty

questions.explanation: Respiration is an exothermic reaction that releases heat energy. Germinating peas are actively respiring, which raises the temperature. The dead peas serve as a control.
